name: The first autumn storm
story: Autumn arrives in one afternoon. Rain from the southeast all morning, the cloud on the hills, then the cold front with a black squall line, a roaring gust and a sudden shift to the west. Behind it, a cold, rinsed sky, and at dusk the first ragged clearing.
forecast: STORM WARNING, NO VFR FROM DAWN TO 18:00. Southeast 12-15 kt gusting 24, low cloud and rain from dawn, cloud base 250 m. The cold front 13:30-15:00: gusts to 35 kt, heavy rain, visibility 3 km, veering west. Showers clearing by dusk; a cold night.
